column11: judgement: Novartis lists PAC001 (pacibekitug) in ASCVD at Phase 2 with a first planned submission of 2029 or later (Novartis Q2 2026 interim report, selected pipeline table, and the novartis.com pipeline read 2026-09-28; the FY2025 20-F 0001114448-26-000004 calls it 'a Phase III-ready anti-IL-6 monoclonal antibody'), and no Phase 3 is registered (ClinicalTrials.gov, searched 2026-09-28 for pacibekitug and TOUR006: only TRANQUILITY and spiriTED). TRANQUILITY's investigator named a 'larger, longer-term phase III trial' as the next step (ESC press release, 2026-08-29) without a date, so an outcomes trial starts in 2027 at the earliest. hsCRP is not an approvable endpoint, so the label needs a MACE trial. Kerendia, first approved on an event-driven cardiorenal outcomes trial, went from FIDELIO-DKD's start (NCT02540993, 2015-09-17) to approval on 2021-07-09 (NDA215341, openFDA) and a first full year in 2022, 6.3 years; 2027 plus 6.3 years makes 2033 the first full year
